label: Medical, Dental, Vision
assignment: Discover realistic medical, dental, and vision resources for uninsured, underinsured, or otherwise underserved people in {service_area}. Follow health systems and referral networks to specific clinics, specialty services, labs, prescriptions, dental care, eye care, coverage programs, and transportation. Verify clinical scope, urgency, cost, insurance, eligibility, appointments, and referral requirements.
include: Primary, preventive, urgent, specialty, reproductive, and chronic-condition care
Dental prevention, pain, infection, extraction, restoration, dentures, and specialty referral
Vision exams, glasses, low-vision services, and ophthalmology pathways
Labs, imaging, prescriptions, equipment, insurance or Medicaid enrollment, and charity care
Mobile, school, immigrant, homeless, disability-accessible, telehealth, and transportation-supported care
exclude: Emergency departments presented as routine care when safer ongoing access exists
Commercial discount advertising without a defined low-cost or charity program
Clinics whose stated specialty, payer, referral, or residency rules make access unrealistic

sourceChannels: official clinic, health-system, and public-health pages
federal and state provider directories that link to operating providers

focuses.label: Primary, preventive, and urgent care
focuses.direction: Find concrete clinics for uninsured or underinsured patients and verify sliding fees, appointments, walk-ins, age limits, and service scope.

focuses.label: Dental access
focuses.direction: Find named dental clinics and programs spanning prevention, pain and infection, extraction, restoration, dentures, and specialty referrals.

focuses.label: Vision and eye-care access
focuses.direction: Find practical pathways for exams, glasses, low-vision services, and medically necessary ophthalmology for people facing cost barriers.

focuses.label: Specialty, diagnostics, prescriptions, and coverage
focuses.direction: Trace primary care or health systems to named specialty, lab, imaging, prescription, equipment, insurance-enrollment, and charity-care pathways.

focuses.label: Population-specific, mobile, and accessible care
focuses.direction: Find direct care designed for people experiencing homelessness, immigrants, children, older adults, disabilities, or transportation barriers.
